name: moai
note: The Lament of Innocence bonus (src/game/hooks.cpp): a walk recorded from the courtyard back across the bridge to the far end of 5.0 (routes/moai.json, short of the potion there), then to the left of it, where the Moai floats with the setting on (--set lament_save=true) and nothing does without it; the pickup's notice says which.

steps.note: facing where the Moai floats, some way off

ask.question: Anywhere on the screen, the left side too, is there an item floating in the air shaped like a stone head, a Moai (an Easter Island statue's head; small and far off, in this light it can look brown)? The blue and gold pot is another item, the potion: it is not a Moai.

choices.moai: yes, a stone Moai head floats somewhere on the screen
choices.none: no stone head anywhere, only other items such as the blue and gold pot

steps.note: over the spot: the pickup's notice

ask.question: Is there an item pickup notice on the screen (a small framed label at the bottom with an item's name)? Which item?
